fields.FIR_Description: On 2025-11-15 at about 22:00, it was reported that Sangeetha Bai was allegedly surrounded and attacked by several persons near Kalai Layout Parking Area after a dispute over a parking issue. The complaint was lodged by Deepak Gopal (9000000484) on behalf of Sangeetha Bai, whose contact number is given as 9000000261. Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Karthik Velan, using the number 9000000188. Items referenced in the complaint: CCTV footage and physical documents.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Several persons reportedly attacked the victim in a secluded stretch.
fields.Keywords: group assault, injury, CCTV, mobile number, documents, night, parking area, suspect
